title: injector.world crawl manifest entry
description: Schema for one manifest record produced per seeded URL by the crawl tasks (T5-T12).

url.description: The seeded URL that was crawled.

device.description: Viewport/profile used for this crawl pass.

status.description: Outcome of the crawl: ok = loaded, error = failed, blocked = bot detection.

load_time_ms.description: Time from navigation start to load event, in milliseconds.

console_errors.description: Console error messages observed on this page.

broken_images.description: Src URLs of images that failed to load.

issues.description: QA issues found on this page.

tested_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the crawl completed.

bot_blocked.description: Optional: true if the site served a bot-detection / challenge page instead of real content.
